_doc: Plan 027. Central Market sale proceeds. net = floor(price * (1 - tax) * (1 + vp_bonus if Value Pack + fame_pct / 100)), rates in basis points (server/ew/market.py net_proceeds, app/shared/ewcore.js netProceeds).
pearl_tax_exempt: Pearl items (Pearl Shop costumes and outfits sold on the market) follow their own rules; these rates cover silver items only.

fame_steps._doc: Family Fame sale bonus in percent of the after-tax amount. Step thresholds are community-reported; the operator types the bonus they see in game into config/local.json market.fame_pct (0-1.5).

preorder_note: listing fills only from pre-orders at max; >= 20 B items fill at random
